name: Reels in a phone fan
what: Your reels fan out like a hand of phones under a headline, in front of you in the lower half: the headline lines rise in, the five phones rise together and fan out with a small overshoot, each screen a reel with a play icon, a view count and a progress bar that runs; the hand sways while it holds, then folds away.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f1 the headline lines rise in one after another (3 f apart, 8 f, slow end; the last line's box opens from the middle, 7 f S-curve); f3-f13 the five phones rise together 150 px from below (slow end, fading in over 3 f); the inner pair fans out from f9, the outer pair from f11 (12 f, slow end with a small overshoot), each tilting 8.5 degrees a step and dropping on an arc; the screens' progress bars run; in the hold the hand sways 1.1 degrees from a wrist far below (96 f) and each phone bobs 3 px out of step; the last 10 f the phones fold back and drop 90 px (accelerating) and the headline lifts away (8 f, one frame apart).

tracks.name: headline
tracks.what: the headline lines rise in one after another, the last on a box

tracks.name: phones up
tracks.what: the five phones rise together from below

tracks.name: fan inner
tracks.what: the two phones beside the middle fan out and tilt

tracks.name: fan outer
tracks.what: the two outer phones fan out, tilt and drop on the arc

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: the hand sways, the phones bob out of step, the progress bars run

tracks.name: out
tracks.what: the phones fold back and drop, the headline lifts away

min_why: the phones fan out and are seen a moment before they fold away
